clues: This city is the capital of a province in the Philippines. It is the seat of the province leaders.
High hills east of here block the trade winds for months. The land stays dry then, with almost no rain from February to April.
In 1898, men met here to write laws for a new land. Their work set up the First Philippine Republic, led by Emilio Aguinaldo.
The free land born here is often called the first true law-based republic in Asia. That is a big claim for one small city.
The convent of the great church here served as the palace of the first leader. He led the new republic from those rooms.
